integrity.claim_scope: deterministic compact interior invariant probability measures
integrity.proof_basis: two invariant-measure balance identities, an exact rational Jensen-defect identity, and Cauchy–Schwarz

limitations: The theorem constrains compactly supported invariant measures in the strict positive quadrant; it does not classify their existence or uniqueness.
The stochastic extension requires separate Ito corrections and is not covered.
A complete statement-level full-text comparison with the closely related 2022 predecessor was unavailable; this is retained as an originality risk.
title: Exact mean-nullcline defect and fluctuation coupling in a fear–crowding predator–prey flow
